nodes.label: tunnel_url Global Variable
nodes.rationale: Must be a stable public URL across restarts so the phone/webhook configuration never needs manual re-editing.

nodes.label: SQLite State Store (Dedupe and Trade History)
nodes.norm_label: sqlite state store (dedupe and trade history)

nodes.label: pytz Inverted Timezone Offset Convention
nodes.rationale: pytz Etc/GMT signs are inverted: Etc/GMT-2 is GMT+2. Getting it wrong shifts every entry time, so the convention is called out explicitly.

nodes.label: Degraded Startup Without Blocking Input
nodes.rationale: Earlier versions prompted for risk settings with input(), which hangs forever under a service manager with no stdin; startup now never asks for input so a restart cannot hang.

nodes.label: Martingale Recovery Strategy
nodes.rationale: Martingale multiplies the stake after a loss to recover; unbounded it can wipe an account, so every leg is bounded by hard risk limits and a sequence is bounded by MAX_SEQUENCE_EXPOSURE.

nodes.label: Risk Controls and Limits
nodes.rationale: Limits are re-checked before every order including each recovery leg, so raising martingale levels or multiplier without raising the exposure ceiling causes sequences to be rejected rather than sized recklessly.

nodes.label: Stable Public Webhook URL Requirement
nodes.rationale: The URL must stay identical across restarts, otherwise the MacroDroid tunnel_url variable must be edited by hand every time; ngrok free dev domains provide this.

nodes.label: Webhook Authentication (x-webhook-secret)
nodes.rationale: Any tunnel URL is publicly reachable, so an unauthenticated webhook could let anyone trigger trades; the secret is compared in constant time before body parsing and broker calls.

nodes.label: Webhook Secret Rotation
nodes.rationale: The secret is generated once, not on every start: rotating on each restart would invalidate the value stored in MacroDroid and reject every signal until the phone was updated by hand.

nodes.label: Theme Toggle with Pre-Paint Theme Application
nodes.norm_label: theme toggle with pre-paint theme application
nodes.rationale: Theme is read from localStorage and applied before first paint so the desk never flashes the wrong ground colour; private mode falls back to the dark default.
